meta.notes: Redis in-memory data store. Single-threaded event loop, RESP protocol, optional ACL, optional TLS. Default config is fully open (nopass + allcommands).

entry_points.accepts: Raw TCP stream, RESP protocol or inline commands
entry_points.notes: connSocketAcceptHandler → acceptCommonHandler → createClient → readQueryFromClient. Up to max_new_conns_per_cycle per event loop.

entry_points.accepts: TLS-wrapped TCP stream with optional client cert
entry_points.notes: tlsAcceptHandler. Client cert CN can auto-authenticate against ACL user if tls-auth-clients is set. No password needed if cert matches.

entry_points.accepts: Unix socket stream, always treated as local
entry_points.notes: connUnixAcceptHandler. connUnixIsLocal always returns 1, so protected mode never triggers.
Pre-auth: up to 10 elements, 1MB querybuf. Post-auth: INT_MAX elements. Initial argv alloc capped at 1024.
sdssplitargs() parses shell-like quoting. No bound on argument count, only total line length.

entry_points.accepts: Parsed command argv from RESP/inline protocol
entry_points.notes: Auth check at line 4463. CMD_NO_AUTH commands (AUTH, HELLO, QUIT, RESET) bypass. ACL check at line 4480.

entry_points.accepts: SYNC/PSYNC commands from authenticated replica clients
entry_points.notes: syncCommand. Normal auth + ACL flow applies. Triggers full or partial resync.

entry_points.accepts: listening-port, ip-address (max 256 bytes), capa, ack, rdb-channel

entry_points.path: RDB bulk transfer (replica receives from master)
entry_points.notes: readSyncBulkPayload. Runs after PSYNC handshake. No per-chunk size validation. Parses untrusted RDB from master.

entry_points.accepts: Raw TCP/TLS connections on port+10000. Up to 1000 accepts/cycle.
entry_points.notes: clusterAcceptHandler. NO AUTHENTICATION. 4-byte signature 'RCmb' and version check only. Any peer reaching bus port can inject cluster messages.
clusterProcessPacket. No cryptographic auth. Unknown senders accepted for MEET/PING/PONG. Buffer grows up to 1MB increments.
configSetCommand. Requires @admin ACL. PROTECTED_CONFIG items (dir, dbfilename) gated by enable-protected-configs. IMMUTABLE items cannot be changed at runtime.

sink_details.notes: MODULE LOAD <path>. Path from c->argv[2]->ptr. No path sanitization. Requires CMD_ADMIN + CMD_PROTECTED (enable-module-command). Full RCE as Redis process user.
EVAL command. Script body is attacker-supplied. Lua sandbox loads os module — os.execute() availability needs verification. Requires @scripting ACL, not @admin.
FUNCTION LOAD. Same Lua sandbox as EVAL.
Classic write-anywhere chain: CONFIG SET dir /etc → CONFIG SET dbfilename passwd → BGSAVE. No path sanitization. Protected by enable-protected-configs (default OFF).
Filename derived from server.rdb_filename + server.rdb_dir, both CONFIG SET-able. Chained with SINK-004.
Parses binary RDB into Redis objects. RESTORE command (auth required) or replication (post-handshake, no per-chunk auth). LZF decompress trusts clen/len from stream. CRC64 check for RESTORE only.
DEBUG REPLICATE <string>. Injects arbitrary commands to all replicas. Requires CMD_ADMIN + CMD_PROTECTED.
DEBUG SLEEP/SEGFAULT/PANIC. No upper bound on sleep. Server-freezing DoS or crash. Requires CMD_ADMIN + CMD_PROTECTED.
DEBUG RESTART / DEBUG CRASH-AND-RECOVER. Restarts Redis process. server.executable from argv[0] at startup.

boundary_details.gaps: Only triggers when DefaultUser has USER_FLAG_NOPASS. If requirepass is set, protected mode does nothing — password is the gate. Does not apply to EP-003 (unix socket always local).
CMD_NO_AUTH commands (AUTH, HELLO, QUIT, RESET) bypass. Default user starts nopass + allcommands — any fresh instance is wide open. requirepass is runtime-settable by authenticated users.
c->user == NULL = unconditional bypass (cluster internal auth path). AOF client skips ACL during loading. Default user ALLCOMMANDS fast path short-circuits all checks.
c->user == NULL = bypass. Default user has ALLKEYS.
c->user == NULL = bypass. Unsubscribe ops skip channel ACL check.
enable-protected-configs defaults to NO — dir and dbfilename are freely changeable by any authenticated admin user. Must be set in config file (IMMUTABLE_CONFIG).
enable-debug-command and enable-module-command default to NO. Check runs before ACL. If set to 'yes' and ACL allows @dangerous, full DEBUG/MODULE surface is exposed.
TLS cert CN auto-authenticates as matching ACL user with no password. tls-auth-clients optional allows cert-less connections. Disabled user check is present.
Hardcoded username 'internal connection'. Success sets c->user = NULL = full ACL bypass. Cluster secret is sole gate. Exposure of secret = complete unrestricted access.
1MB querybuf limit for unauth clients. Master clients have no limit. Limit check leaks auth status (server drops >1MB before auth vs accepts after).
Unauth clients limited to 10 multibulk elements. Arguments are parsed and createObject called before auth check in processCommand.

unchecked_flows.missing_boundary: Cluster bus has no cryptographic auth. 4-byte signature 'RCmb' only. Any peer reaching bus port (default: client_port+10000) can inject arbitrary gossip, failover requests, or PUBLISH messages.
Default config: nopass + allcommands + enable-protected-configs=no. Fresh Redis instance allows CONFIG SET dir/dbfilename → BGSAVE for arbitrary file write without any authentication.
Default config: nopass + @scripting enabled. Lua EVAL with os module loaded — os.execute() availability in sandbox needs verification. Any unauthenticated client can execute Lua scripts.
Replica receives RDB from master post-handshake with no per-chunk validation. Compromised master can send crafted RDB. LZF decompress trusts attacker-supplied lengths.
If enable-module-command=yes and default config (nopass + allcommands): unauthenticated MODULE LOAD gives full RCE. Default is protected (enable-module-command=no), but misconfiguration is common.
Cluster bus RESTORE-like operations can trigger rdbLoadObject with attacker-crafted payloads. No auth on cluster bus beyond 4-byte signature.
